subject: maths
question: The speed of a motor-boat in still water and the speed of the current of water are in the ratio 20 ∶ 4. To go a certain distance along the current the boat takes 4 hours. Find the time taken by the boat to cover the same distance against the current.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream Speed : Upstream Speed = (20 + 4) : (20 − 4) = 24 : 16 = 3 : 2

For a constant distance, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Time Downstream : Time Upstream = 2 : 3

Given Downstream Time (2 parts) = 4 hours, which means 1 part = 2 hours.

Upstream Time (3 parts) = 3 × 2 = 6 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of the speed of the motor-boat in still water to the speed of the current = 20 : 4 = 5 : 1

Let the speed of the boat in still water be 5k and the speed of the current be k.

Time taken to cover a certain distance downstream = 4 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Downstream Speed = Speed of boat + Speed of current

Upstream Speed = Speed of boat − Speed of current

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a511a63e0e00f62be742e085ebe19db7b55f1acdc0fc775ac452ba4647b967ae.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed = 5k + k = 6k

⇒ Upstream Speed = 5k − k = 4k

⇒ Distance covered downstream = 6k × 4 = 24k

⇒ Since the boat covers the same distance, distance to be covered upstream = 24k

⇒ Time taken upstream = Distance ÷ Upstream Speed

⇒ Time taken upstream = 24k ÷ 4k = 6 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 6 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream and Upstream Speed

If v is the speed of the boat in still water and u is the speed of the stream, then Downstream speed (D) = v + u and Upstream speed (U) = v − u.

Boat and Stream Speed Formula

When downstream speed (D) and upstream speed (U) are given, Speed of boat in still water = (D + U) ÷ 2 and Speed of current = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed in Stream Journeys

When a boat travels from point A to point B downstream and immediately returns from point B to point A upstream, the average speed for the round trip is given by (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).
